Editing Bay

Pick how to start. The editor mounts right here in LoadStudio - no jump, no iframe. Same VN-style timeline you saw in Load Main.

Provider Status Report

Provider Status

See which providers were tried, what succeeded, and what needs manual review. No generation result is accepted without proof.

Provider Log

No provider attempts logged yet.

Add Manual Entry

Integration Required: Live provider calls require a connected API. Logging, export, and the No False Success rules work offline. No generation result is accepted without a real file, blob, or URL on record.

No False Success Rules

  • Never mark a generation as complete unless a real file, blob, URL, or base64 data was returned.
  • Never claim video was generated unless a playable video file exists.
  • Never claim image was generated unless a visible image file exists.
  • Never claim audio was generated unless a playable audio file exists.
  • Never mark as published unless the content reached Load Play or a backend endpoint.

Load Studio™

Welcome to Load Studio™

Save your projects, access them on every device, and publish to Load Play™. Account is local to this device.

Install LoadStudio on your iPad.Tap the icon on your home screen, opens fullscreen, works offline.

Install LoadStudio on your iPad

No App Store needed. Add LoadStudio to your home screen and it opens fullscreen, with offline support, just like any other app.

  1. Make sure you're viewing this in Safari (not in another app's web view).
  2. Tap the Share button at the top of Safari.
  3. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
  4. Keep the name as "LoadStudio" (or rename it), then tap Add.
  5. Open it from your home screen anytime. Works with Airplane Mode on. No tracking.
Page is zoomed in. Pinch out to reset, or tap Fix.
